messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Miller <ethan@finstart.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing & committed-use discount discussion — FinStart

Hi Ethan —

Great to chat earlier. Quick recap and suggested next steps from our discovery: 

Summary of what I heard
- Primary use case: real-time document summarization and contextual chat for customer support workflows.
- Estimated steady-state volume: ~1.5B tokens/month (peaks to ~3B on heavy days)
- Current target latency/throughput: <200ms average response for chat flows; bulk offline embedding jobs run overnight
- Security: standard SOC2 + VPC peering desired for production

Pricing qualification items (need confirmation)
1) Confirm monthly token estimate: you noted ~1.5B tokens/month as a conservative baseline — is that correct?
2) What is your budget range for inference (monthly)? you mentioned ~$25k/mo as an initial number in the call but said you wanted to confirm.
3) Target unit economics: What would be an acceptable $/1M tokens for you (e.g. $10/1M, $8/1M)?

Redwood programs that may help
- Startup program: one-time onboarding credits and reduced list pricing for early stage companies (seed/series A). I can check eligibility and the credit amount.
- Committed-use discounts: multi-month/year commitments with higher discounts for longer terms. We typically offer 12 and 24 month tiers; we can model to get you to a target $/1M tokens.

Next steps
- Can you confirm the monthly token baseline and budget range?
- If you can share a simple token profile (day-by-day/month-by-month) I'll run a committed-use model and share options (12m/24m, % discounts and implied $/1M).

I attached a short pricing guide that shows example committed-use math and our startup program summary.

Thanks — talk soon.

Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com | (415) 555-0184
https://redwood.ai

Attachment: pricing_guide.pdf (summary of list pricing, example commitment math, startup program blurb)

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 10:11:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Pricing & committed-use discount discussion — FinStart

Marissa / Dylan —

Looping you in on FinStart (Ethan Miller). They are solid seed-stage product company, looking at ~1.5B tokens/month baseline and target ~$10/1M tokens. Budget initial $25k/mo but would consider bigger commit if unit price hits target.

What I'm proposing we offer as options (please validate/approve):
- Startup program: qualify for 6 months of 50% usage credits up to $10k total (one-time) + SBP onboarding support.
- Committed-use option A (12 months): $180k annual commit (~$15k/month) -> implies $10/1M tokens at 1.5B/mo (math below). Offer 20% off list pricing.
- Committed-use option B (24 months): $330k total ($13.75k/month) -> implies ~$9.17/1M tokens at same volume. Offer 30% off list pricing for 24m.

Quick math (12m): 1.5B tokens/mo * 12 = 18B tokens/year = 18,000M tokens. $180,000 / 18,000 = $10 per 1M tokens.

Ask: can we approve the 12m at $180k (20% off) and 24m at $330k (30% off) as standard commercial offers for seed-stage startups? If yes I'll send to Ethan and include startup credit language.

Ben

Ethan —

Thanks for confirming — excited to get you started. Based on the numbers you shared, here are two commercial options plus the startup program credit if you qualify: 

1) Startup program (if eligible)
- One-time onboarding credit: $10,000 applied to your account over the first 6 months.
- Reduced support pricing during the credit period.
- Eligibility: Seed-stage with active product and plans to raise Series A within 12 months. We typically ask for a short verification (cap table or lead investor intro).

2) Committed-use Option A — 12 months- Annual commit: $180,000 (billed monthly or upfront)- Implied unit price: $10 per 1M tokens at 1.5B tokens/mo baseline (1.5B * 12 = 18B tokens = 18,000M; $180k / 18,000 = $10)- Discount: ~20% off list (standard for this tier)
3) Committed-use Option B — 24 months- Total commit: $330,000 over 24 months ($13,750/mo effective)- Implied unit price: ~$9.17 per 1M tokens at same baseline- Discount: ~30% off list

Notes and next steps
- If you want to lower the $/1M further we can size a higher commit.
- I've attached a one-page offer PDF with the two commitment options and the startup credit terms. If this looks good we can send a short DocuSign for the commitment and get procurement started.
- If procurement needs an SOW/PO-friendly billing schedule we can map that in the agreement.

Link to offer & sign: https://www.docusign.com/abcdef123456
Attachment: proposed_commitment_offer.pdf

If you confirm which option you prefer (12m with startup credit or 24m), I'll route the contract and get Marissa to finalize commercial terms.

Best,
